title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EnergyUsageEfficiency
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/EnergyUsageEfficiency. Represents the efficiency of energy usage in a resource.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnergyUsageEfficiency'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

certifications.description: Relationship. Legal documents certifying the energy usage efficiency. Links to one or more LegalDocument entities.

powerUsageEffectiveness.description: Property. The effectiveness of power usage (PUE).
